title: Neuron Foundry
lede: Design a small neural network and train it live, right here in your browser: backprop and Adam, written from scratch, no libraries and no server. Three datasets a day, from gentle gaussians to a spiral. Watch the decision boundary drift into place like a current, and hit 95% test accuracy with as few parameters as you can.
description: Neuron Foundry: design and train a neural network live in the browser, and watch its decision boundary form on classic 2-D datasets.
